answer: Correlated-fault penalties make a fake-key farm punish itself. When a staked agent key misses an audit or casts a losing jury vote, a lone error costs 1% of its stake. A gale is any epoch where over 5% of keys make the identical error; every key in a gale pays 3%. Keys whose errors stay independent remain on the velvet tier of 1% fines, while a key caught in 3 gales is flagged violet and loses its jury seat. A farm of 500 keys driven by one model errs in unison, so each shared mistake fines all 500 at triple rate.
